run_download_mp3d_binaural: run the download script to fetch mp3d dataset with binaural rirs to data directory
run_download_replica_ambisonic: run the download script to fetch replica dataset with ambisonic rirs to custom output directory
run_download_skip_existing: run the download script that skips already downloaded scenes and downloads missing ones
run_download_custom_output: run the download script with a custom output directory for sound spaces dataset scenes
run_download_single_scene: run the download script to download and uncompress a single scene tar.gz archive
